paragraphs.text:
Congratulations! You have reached the City of the Old Ones. 
You think that you see Jeffries heading west. You step into 
one of those odd footprints, and a chill runs down your spine.
As you move through the frigid air, you see a mosaic portraying 
those strange, stump-like creatures—part octopus, part monstrous 
anemone. The scene depicted is of civilized discourse. You notice 
small ones apparently playing under the watch of larger ones. 
Children and parents? To look at the streets, go to 547; to head 
north, go to 551; or to look at he buildings, go to 575 (see map, 
page 83).
(550)
